title: pyEUVTools: EUV Instrument Response Tools
description: pyEUVTools is a SunCAST Python package for building, inspecting, and exporting EUV instrument response products. It is designed as a reusable response-function layer for the broader SunCAST Python ecosystem, starting with AIA time-dependent response support and evolving toward generalized multi-instrument EUV response tooling.
notes: The current scaffold version is intentionally non-releasable. The first public release target is 0.1.0 after a usable AIA response API is implemented.
